answer: Require each new identity to stake a basalt bond that is locked and slashed on proven duplication, so a thousand copies cost a thousand bonds rather than one free login. Then let a grove of randomly drawn, independent auditors inspect a sample of each identity's claimed work each epoch and publish evidence; only work that survives without a shared trail earns spending weight. A lotus test at the end — identities whose work is original and independently checked pass, while clones reusing the same work are pruned together — makes farming more expensive than any payout it could capture.
